title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Zero Data Retention & Private Safety: OpenAI previewed Private Safety Processing to enforce safety filters across frontier models without logging customer prompts or response content.
Terminal-Code Brings VS Code to CLI: Developers unveiled terminal-code, a CLI tool enabling native VS Code extension compatibility and terminal theme sync over SSH.
OpenCode & OpenRouter Launch Ox Alpha: OpenCode and OpenRouter introduced Ox Alpha, a 1M-context multimodal stealth model with expanded usage limits for developers.
Justin Sun Wins Court Ruling vs World Liberty: Federal judge denied World Liberty Financial's bid to force Justin Sun's multi-hundred-million-dollar lawsuit into secret arbitration.
Student Loan & Housing Cost Debates Go Viral: Detailed financial breakdowns exposed systemic interest compounding on decade-old student loans and unexpected property tax escrow surges.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Previews Private Safety Processing for ZDR
items.body: OpenAI previewed Private Safety Processing, enabling automated safety enforcement across frontier models while preserving Zero Data Retention without OpenAI personnel viewing prompt content.

items.title: @aidenybai: Terminal-Code Integrates VS Code with CLI Terminals
items.body: Developer Rob Pruzan released terminal-code, a CLI utility bringing native VS Code extension support, SSH connectivity, and terminal theme synchronization into command-line environments.

items.title: @thdxr: OpenCode & OpenRouter Introduce Ox Alpha Stealth Model
items.body: OpenCode expanded usage quotas for Muse Spark 1.2 and Hy3 models while joining OpenRouter to release Ox Alpha, a 1M-context multimodal model built for sustained agentic work.

items.title: @ClaudeDevs: Claude Platform GA Release for Computer Use & Skills API
items.body: Anthropic announced general availability for Computer Use, browser automation, Skills API, and Files API, enabling low-latency multi-step agentic workflows.

items.title: @OpenAIDevs: OpenAI Releases Open-Source Codex Harness
items.body: OpenAI published its open-source Codex harness, allowing developers to embed autonomous coding agent loops, context management, and sandbox controls into custom developer tools.

items.title: @cline: FrontierCode Benchmark Insights on Thinking Tiers
items.body: Cline published benchmark findings showing Opus 5 on medium thinking effort outperformed extra-high thinking mode by 10% while cutting task execution costs by 50%.

items.title: @justinsuntron: Federal Court Rules Justin Sun Lawsuit Stays Open
items.body: A federal judge ruled that Justin Sun's lawsuit against World Liberty Financial over token freezes and $450M initial investment terms will proceed in open court rather than secret arbitration.

items.title: @Owennfa: Decade-Long Student Loan Balance Calculation Sparks Outrage
items.body: A borrower highlighted how paying $55,000 over 11 years on an original $32,000 student loan principal resulted in a remaining balance of $28,900 due to compounding interest structures.

items.title: @Leonajardinho: Fixed-Rate Mortgage Escrow & Tax Increases Breakdown
items.body: A homeowner case study illustrated how property tax reassessments and skyrocketing insurance premiums increased monthly mortgage obligations by $700 overnight despite fixed principal rates.

items.title: @web3annie: CZ Reflects on Voluntary Legal Process & Industry Accountability
items.body: Binance co-founder CZ publicly addressed his decision to voluntarily resolve US regulatory charges without seeking non-extradition protection, emphasizing long-term ecosystem responsibility.

items.title: @pritipatelfgoo: Price-Volume Alignment Factor in Quantitative Trading
items.body: Quantitative research detailed a price-volume alignment factor engineered to capture market crowding and trade mean-reversion when asset prices diverge from volume trends.

items.title: @theMadridZone: Toni Kroos Endorses Kvaratskhelia for Ballon d'Or
items.body: Toni Kroos stated that Khvicha Kvaratskhelia deserves top honors for the Ballon d'Or, praising his consistent game-changing influence at the club level throughout the season.

items.title: @oooodjdjd: Zhang Yiming's Career Principles Speech for Graduates
items.body: A viral transcript of ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming detailed early career lessons at Kuxun, emphasizing borderless ownership, curiosity, and resisting premature gratification.

items.title: @Footballera0: Man City & Spurs Reach Verbal Agreement for Savinho
items.body: Manchester City and Tottenham reached a verbal agreement for the transfer of winger Savinho in a deal valued over £75m as talks continue for Omar Marmoush.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Uli Hoeneß on Jürgen Klopp's DFB Appointment
items.body: Bayern Munich honorary president Uli Hoeneß commented on Jürgen Klopp becoming Germany's national team manager, urging supporters to afford him tactical development time.

items.title: @jiangyelab1: Retrospective on Personal Growth & Domain Mastery Tipping Points
